betterquesting:10.desc:8:
So you have made yourself an Eternal DTPF or hopefully a few, and now it is time for the push onwards.

Beyond the Stars replaces TecTech's Eye of Harmony with §bone Eye that grows from tier 1 to tier 10§r. It grows one band at a time, with a §blive star§r at its centre.

§e§lWHAT IT IS§r
Put a §bStar Chart§r in the controller slot (it is not consumed) to choose what the Eye runs: Star Chart: Sol at T1. A dimension display block runs planets instead (see §cPlanets on the Eye§r).

§e§lBUILD§r
Hologram stack 1 = the T1 core, 102 × 52 × 80. It is mostly TecTech's own Eye blocks:
- Reinforced Spatial and Temporal Structure Casings;
- Infinite SpaceTime Energy Boundary Casing;
- Quantum Glass;
- the three field generator families.
On the plinth go gas input hatches (Hydrogen, Helium), an input bus for Stellar Ignition Charges, an ME Output Bus and an ME Output Hatch. Power is §bwireless EU only§r. Chunk-load the whole footprint.

§e§lLIGHT IT§r Sol lights when all of these hold:
- a §bStellar Ignition Charge§r is in a plinth input bus;
- the buffers hold 10 cycles of upkeep plus a seed cloud of §b100,000,000 L Hydrogen and 100,000,000 L Helium§r;
- the wireless network holds 10 cycles of EU.
The protostar contracts for about 40 seconds, then lights.

§e§lRUN§r Every §b60 s cycle§r, Sol burns §b50,000,000 L Hydrogen + 50,000,000 L Helium§r and §b1.51 × 10¹¹ EU§r, and makes §b50,000 L Raw Star Matter§r to the ME output hatch. Inputs drain into internal buffers every second, so ME stocking hatches are fine on the gas sockets. Upkeep is paid in full even when the star runs badly.

[warn]The §lSpacetime Compression Field Generators gate the tier§r: an Eye of tier N needs every compression generator at tier N or higher. Crude runs T1.[/warn]

[note]The Eye is a pure power sink. It makes matter, not EU. The next quests teach the stability field, planets, and how to unlock T2; the controller tooltip and GUI have the rest.[/note]

§a§lDONE WHEN§r you hold the controller, Star Chart: Sol and an Ignition Charge (HOLD → CLAIM → INSTALL).

[note]The pack's own Eye of Harmony quest is left as the pack wrote it, because pack edits are turned off (questbookPackEdits in config/beyondthestars.cfg).[/note]
